name: Brimstone
overview: The Bible portrays brimstone primarily as a symbol of God's righteous judgment and wrath, vividly illustrated in the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah where fire and brimstone rained down from heaven to overthrow the cities (Genesis 19:24; Deuteronomy 29:23). This imagery extends to other judgments, as brimstone is associated with divine punishment upon the wicked, accompanied by fire and tempest (Psalms 11:6; Ezekiel 38:22). Figuratively, brimstone represents the consuming power of God's anger, kindling judgment like a stream of fire prepared for the enemies of God (Isaiah 30:33; Job 18:15). Thus, brimstone in Scripture underscores the holiness of God who executes just retribution against sin and rebellion.
